phrases.note: Why us: cụ thể, không growth.

example.en: I'm looking for more ownership on backend.
example.vi: Mình tìm ownership backend nhiều hơn.

example.en: This role owns payments, which matches what I do.
example.vi: Role này own payments, khớp việc mình làm.

example.en: Why I'm leaving is I've hit the ceiling on scope.
example.vi: Mình đi vì scope đã chạm trần.

example.en: What I want next is to own a service end to end.
example.vi: Tiếp theo mình muốn own một service end to end.

example.en: That's why I applied to this team.
example.vi: Vì vậy mình apply team này.

pattern.title: Toward, not away
pattern.pattern: I'm looking for… This role… Why I'm leaving is… That's why I applied
pattern.explainVi: Why us / why leave: hướng tới (ownership, scope), gắn JD, không chê sếp. Chốt that's why I applied.

exercises.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: I'm looking for ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: This role ___

aiPrompt.scenario: Why this role and why leave — using the learner's real situation. Stop them if they trash a manager.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: I'm looking for…; This role…; Why I'm leaving is…; What I want next is…; That's why I applied. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Why this role and why leave — using the learner's real situation. Stop them if they trash a manager.
